tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Kaviár Dům range (caviar, crab, fish, seafood) by words in the name, brand, category or description. Accents and case do not matter. Leave query empty to list everything. Returns id, name, weight, current price in CZK with VAT (promotions included), stock and the product page URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything the product page says about one product: full description (composition, storage and origin when the page states them), weight, price and volume tiers, stock, order quantity rules, gift set contents. Nothing beyond what the page says.

tools.name: delivery_options
tools.description: Delivery methods for a Czech postcode, with prices in CZK including VAT, free-delivery thresholds, earliest delivery, courier time windows and the pickup point. Pass items to price delivery for that basket (chilled goods travel only by a cooled carrier, and free delivery depends on the basket value)

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Make a link to a kaviardum.cz basket with these items already in it. Nothing is stored until the person opens the link; they then see the basket, choose delivery and pay on the site. Give the link to the person.
